summary: Updated implementation plan incorporating all 5 technical refinements plus the 3-option OTA Update Dialog (Update Now, Update Later, Remind Me Later with Next Launch / Tomorrow / In 3 Days deferral): (1) Google Android tools apksig ApkVerifier (no JarFile fallback) matched against installed signer, (2) Argon2id settings labeled as proposed until benchmarked on-device across the two-vault unlock path, (3) Unified versioned KeyEnvelope format with encrypted inner payload (no exposed isConfigured column), (4) Complete removal of unused cloud/Firebase/AI plugins and dependencies, and (5) Explicit physical-device vs local-JVM test reporting protocol.
